About Sayari:

Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.

About the Role

Sayari’s customers buy answers to hard problems: who really owns a supplier, where a sanctioned network is moving goods, which alerts deserve an analyst’s time. Sayari’s AI platform Superconductor delivers those answers at machine scale. It is built in the field, with analysts and engineers working alongside customers to define what it needs to do.

The Field Intelligence Analyst brings Sayari’s tradecraft to that work. You scope the problem, design the solution, prove its value, and deliver mission impact. You own the analytical relationship for a portfolio of accounts, from first conversation through sustained delivery. What you learn on live engagements flows back into Superconductor and into Sayari’s tradecraft standard.

You work in our Field Intelligence Department, a global team of analysts deployed to support government agencies and Fortune 500 companies. You sit in the same org as Forward Deployed Engineers and the Product team. The field shapes the roadmap, and Product sets it.

Why This Role Exists

  • Customers buy answers. Superconductor reasons like an expert analyst at machine scale. The analyst’s job shifts from producing every answer by hand to directing, validating, and extending what Superconductor produces, and teaching customer analysts to do the same.
  • Context should survive the contract. The analyst who designed the proof-of-value knows why the success criteria are what they are. Keeping that analyst on the account protects delivery quality and surfaces the next problem before the customer names it.
  • Tradecraft is built in the field. Field Intelligence Analysts see what was promised, what was delivered, and what the customer did with it. That full view produces better methodology, better evals, and a better Superconductor than any single-phase role can.

What You Will Do

Own the analytical relationship, end to end

  • Run discovery and proof-of-value engagements anchored on work the customer already pays people to do, such as alert adjudication, due diligence, investigations, and case prioritization. Define success criteria you will personally be accountable for delivering.
  • Stay on the account after close and deliver the work you scoped. This includes multi-hop investigations across ownership, trade, and corporate records, plus analytical briefings and training.
  • Serve as the customer’s single analytical point of contact from first conversation through renewal.

Build with Field Engineering and Product

  • Pair with FDEs on discovery and delivery. You define the analytical requirement, they build it, and you validate it against the mission.
  • When something built for one customer should be rebuilt for many, make the case to Product with evidence: the problem, the workaround, and the customers who share it.
  • Document where the platform falls short of the mission, with raw examples attached.

Deliver analyst-plus-AI, and teach it

  • Direct Superconductor against live mission problems. Validate its reasoning against expert standards, and extend it into new customer workflows.
  • Train and certify customer analysts on Sayari methods and on working with Superconductor. Identify the customer experts who should go further.

Build the tradecraft

  • Capture the judgment calls, non-obvious pivots, and creative approaches from live engagements. Contribute them to the Tradecraft team as expert-annotated reference cases, eval scenarios, and training material.
  • Hold your work to the Field Intelligence standard, and help raise it.

Support Go-To-Market Teams

  • Work with Sales to diagnose customer problems, scope solutions, and deliver mission impact.

Who You Are

Required

  • A builder’s temperament and comfort with ambiguity. You do well on small teams with end-to-end ownership and no defined lane, working next to engineers on things that don’t exist yet.
  • Experience conducting complex, multi-source investigations in one or more of these areas: financial crime, sanctions and export controls, supply chain and forced labor risk, transnational criminal organizations, or law enforcement and intelligence investigations. This should include work with corporate records, trade data, and OSINT.
  • Customer-facing range. You have scoped engagements, demonstrated capability to skeptical experts, and delivered under a statement of work. Candidates often come from solutions consulting, services delivery, embedded analytics, or mission-support roles.
  • Hands-on fluency directing and evaluating AI and agentic analytical tools. You can define what “right” looks like precisely enough to test against.
  • Clear communication with analysts, program managers, engineers, and executives.

Desired

  • Python or SQL for data manipulation, and familiarity with REST APIs.
  • Experience designing training curricula or certifying analysts.
  • For government portfolios: an active Government security clearance and same citizenship as your country of residence.

Compensation

The target base salary for this position is ¥7,800,000 to ¥11,900,000 in Japan, plus variable bonus and equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, candidate experience-levels and expertise, internal peer equity, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Benefits:

  • 100% fully paid medical, vision, and dental for employees and their dependents
  • Generous time off; we observe all US federal holidays, close our office for a winter break (12/24-12/31), in addition to granting 18 PTO days and 10 sick days
  • Outstanding compensation package; competitive commissions for revenue roles and bonuses for non-revenue positions
  • A strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion
  • Eligibility to participate in additional benefits such as 401k match up to 5%, 100% paid life insurance (up to $100,000 coverage), and parental leave
  • A collaborative and positive culture - your team will be as smart and driven as you
  • Limitless growth and learning opportunities

Sayari is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply. We believe diversity and inclusion mean our team members should reflect the diversity of the United States. No employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on race, color, ethnicity, religion, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability status, veteran status, genetics, or political affiliation. We strongly encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply.

Pay Range

¥7,800,000—¥11,900,000 JPY

Oddball believes that the best products are built when companies understand and value the things they are working on. We value learning and growth and the ability to make a big impact at a small company. We believe that we can make big changes happen and improve the daily lives of millions of people by bringing quality software to the federal space.

We’re looking for a Frontend Engineer to join our VA team, building and maintaining the shared components and forms that help VA.gov teams ship consistent, accessible experiences for Veterans.

What you'll be doing:

  • Build and maintain reusable front-end components using React, JavaScript/TypeScript, and web components
  • Extend and improve the VA Design System component library and Forms Library
  • Fix bugs and handle component requests from product teams across VA.gov
  • Write automated tests and Storybook documentation for the components you ship
  • Meet Section 508 and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards in everything you build
  • Work with designers and engineers to turn Figma designs into working, accessible code
  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude Code to speed up delivery while keeping quality high
  • Take part in code reviews, sprint planning, and Agile ceremonies

What you’ll bring:

  • Hands-on experience with React and JavaScript or TypeScript
  • Solid HTML and CSS skills, including accessible, semantic markup
  • Understanding of accessibility standards such as WCAG and ARIA
  • Experience with design systems, component libraries, or form-heavy applications is a plus
  • Familiarity with Stencil, web components, USWDS, or SCSS is a plus
  • Familiarity with Storybook and component testing is a plus
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools is a plus
  • Thrives in a remote, collaborative Agile environment and genuinely enjoys working with designers and engineers
  • Communicates clearly and openly, whether in a code review or a conversation with a non-technical teammate
  • Performs other related duties as assigned

Requirements:

  • Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. In alignment with federal contract requirements, certain roles may also require U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a federal background investigation and/or a security clearance.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree

Benefits:

  • Fully remote
  • Annual Stipend
  • Comprehensive Benefits Package
  • Company Match 401(k) plan
  • Flexible PTO, Paid Holidays

Oddball is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against applicants based on race, religion, color, disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity or expression, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), age, veteran status or other legally protected characteristics. Any applicant with a mental or physical disability who requires an accommodation during the application process should contact an Oddball HR representative to request such an accommodation by emailing hr@oddball.io

The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60-1.35(c)

At Oddball, we may use AI-assisted tools as part of our recruitment process to help review applications, verify applicant information, and identify potentially fraudulent submissions. These tools support our recruiting team in maintaining a fair and secure hiring process. AI-generated findings are reviewed by our recruiting team and are not used as the sole basis for hiring decisions.

Compensation:

At Oddball, it’s important each employee is compensated competitively and fairly. In alignment with state legal requirements. A range for the included position is listed below. Be advised, actual offer details are determined by job category, job location, and candidate skill level.

United States Wage Range: $100,000 – $130,000

Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

As a Senior Clinical Research Associate, you will play a key role in the successful delivery of clinical trials by independently managing clinical site monitoring and site management activities across Spain and Portugal, from study start-up through close-out. You will act as a primary point of contact for investigative sites in these countries, ensuring compliance with protocols, ICH-GCP, applicable regulations and study requirements while supporting high-quality patient data and study delivery.

This is a senior individual contributor role with responsibility for supporting site performance, resolving issues, maintaining study documentation and providing guidance and mentorship to junior CRAs. You will work closely with Clinical Operations, Project Management, sponsors and other cross-functional teams in a dynamic clinical research environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Independently conduct and document onsite and remote monitoring activities, including site qualification, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits across Portugal and Spain.
  • Ensure investigative sites comply with study protocols, ICH-GCP, applicable regulations, SOPs and project-specific requirements.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned sites, managing site-related questions, issues, action items and protocol deviations through to resolution.
  • Review clinical trial data, source documentation and study systems to ensure accuracy, completeness, data integrity and compliance.
  • Support site selection, activation and recruitment activities, working with sites to achieve study milestones and patient recruitment targets.
  • Ensure sites are appropriately trained on protocols, study systems, processes and applicable requirements throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Maintain oversight of essential study documentation, including ISF and TMF, ensuring documents are complete, accurate and filed in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with sponsors, project teams, vendors and investigative sites to support study timelines, resolve issues and maintain effective working relationships.
  • Participate in audits and inspections, Investigator Meetings, study meetings and other project activities as required.
  • Provide mentoring and support to CRA I and II colleagues, participate in co-monitoring and CRA assessment activities, and contribute to process improvement initiatives.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (Honours) in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing or a related discipline; a Master’s degree is preferred.
  • 4–6 years of relevant clinical research experience, with 7–9 years preferred.
  • Strong clinical site monitoring experience across clinical trial activities from site start-up through close-out.
  • Thorough knowledge of ICH-GCP, clinical research principles and applicable local regulatory requirements.
  • Experience with Phase I–IV clinical trials preferred.
  • Proficiency with clinical trial systems such as EDC, IRT, eTMF, CTMS and Microsoft Office, with experience in systems such as Medidata Rave or Oracle InForm preferred.
  • Strong understanding of site management, including site activation, recruitment, training, issue resolution and maintenance of essential documentation.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal and relationship-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with investigative sites, sponsors and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organisational, problem-solving and prioritisation skills, with a high level of attention to detail and a sense of urgency.
  • Ability to work independently, demonstrate sound judgement and manage competing priorities in a results-driven environment.
  • Experience mentoring or supporting junior CRAs is preferred.
  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 40–60%, depending on project requirements and geographic location.
  • Valid driver’s licence required.
  • Fluent written and verbal English, Spanish and Portuguese

What We Offer

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.

Compensation

Additional Information

Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone. Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit https://mineralystx.com. Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Regional Sales Director

The Regional Sales Director (RSD) will play a critical role in the successful launch and growth of Mineralys’ first commercial product within an assigned region. This leader will be accountable for translating national strategy into regional execution, driving business performance through strong field leadership, cross-functional partnership, and disciplined execution against launch objectives.

The RSD will build and lead a high-performing team of territory managers, foster deep customer relationships, and ensure alignment with corporate priorities, compliance standards, and Mineralys’ values. This is a highly visible field leadership role requiring strong business acumen, launch experience, and the ability to lead with urgency in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership / Launch Execution

  • Lead all regional launch planning and execution activities to ensure successful market entry and sustained product uptake
  • Translate national brand strategy into actionable regional business plans and field execution priorities
  • Lead team to achieve or exceed sales goals, market share targets, and key performance metrics at launch and beyond
  • Monitor market dynamics, customer feedback, and competitive intelligence to adjust strategy in real time
  • Drive accountability for performance through data-driven decision making and disciplined execution

Team Leadership / Coaching

  • Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain top-performing territory managers across the region
  • Lead, coach, and motivate a team of approximately 8–12 territory managers
  • Establish and maintain high level of disease state, clinical and product knowledge
  • Evaluate performance of territory managers and coach to skill and career development through regular field contact
  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Build strong succession plans and talent pipelines

Customer / Market Engagement

  • Develop and maintain relationships with key healthcare providers, health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs) and strategic accounts
  • Partner with territory managers on key customer interactions, access challenges, and develop account strategies
  • Support pull-through with IDNs, organized customers, and priority accounts
  • timely and effectively sharing of customer insights with internal stakeholders

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Market Access, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Training, Operations, and HR to support launch readiness and execution
  • Provide field-driven input into brand planning, messaging, and tactical adjustments
  • Collaborate with Area Sales Directors and peers to share best practices and drive consistency across regions
  • Support national meetings, launch planning sessions, and field communications

Compliance / Operational Excellence

  • Ensure all regional activities are conducted in full compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and legal standards
  • Manage regional budgets and resources effectively
  • Maintain accurate forecasting, CRM utilization, and reporting discipline
  • Uphold Mineralys’ values of collaboration, integrity, quality, trust, and urgency

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
  • 8+ years of pharmaceutical / biotech sales experience
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience in a district / regional manager role
  • Proven success leading specialty sales teams and exceeding performance goals
  • Prior launch experience required; first-launch / startup biotech experience strongly preferred
  • Experience in cardiovascular, nephrology, hypertension, or related specialty markets strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated success in recruiting and developing top talent
  • Strong business planning, analytical, and coaching skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment
  • Willingness to travel extensively within region

Leadership Profile

  • A strong coach who develops people and builds winning teams
  • Highly accountable, with a bias for action and urgency
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and helping build infrastructure
  • Collaborative and able to influence across functions
  • Resilient, adaptable, and energized by launch environments

Travel

  • This position requires up to 60% travel. Frequently travel is outside the local area and overnight.

These positions are eligible for standard Company benefits including medical, dental, vision, time off and 401K, as well as participating in Mineralys incentive plans are contingent on achievement of personal and company performance. Actual compensation may vary from posted hiring range based on geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level.

US Salary Range: $210,000-$235,000

About the Role

Appen’s Strategic Project Leads turn complex technical requirements into high-quality data and evaluation resources that help advance AI models.

As the Strategic Project Lead for Physical Engineering, you will bring deep engineering knowledge to projects involving the physical world and built environment. You will help translate real-world engineering work into structured tasks, expert-reviewed data and evaluations that support AI training and model assessment.

You will bring depth in at least one physical engineering discipline, such as mechanical, electrical, civil or structural engineering, while working with specialists across other areas as needed. You will partner with customers, Applied Researchers, Operations and technical experts to shape project requirements, establish quality standards and deliver technically credible results.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will lead through subject matter expertise and influence, rather than direct people management.

Your Impact

  • Translate customer requirements into realistic engineering tasks, data specifications and measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Assess technical requirements, review source files and develop representative samples to establish project feasibility.
  • Shape the physical engineering domain strategy across areas such as CAD, BIM, CAE and electrical engineering.
  • Develop multi-step engineering tasks and reference solutions that reflect real-world technical challenges across models, drawings, calculations and specifications.
  • Lead pilots from sample development and expert onboarding through quality assurance and customer acceptance.
  • Partner with Operations to transition projects into production, maintaining technical standards and ownership of domain quality as delivery scales.
  • Build and qualify a network of specialist engineering contributors and reviewers.
  • Work with Applied Researchers and tooling teams to develop technical verification methods and improve the consistency of engineering evaluations.
  • Provide effort estimates and identify specialist requirements, tooling needs and delivery risks to support commercial proposals.
  • Turn successful projects into reusable engineering samples, task libraries and delivery methods.

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.
  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience in at least one physical engineering discipline, with a background in applied engineering work and technical problem-solving.
  • Practical experience with engineering tools and CAE workflows, including interpreting analyses and validating assumptions, constraints and results.
  • Experience working with technical artefacts such as CAD or BIM models, engineering drawings, schematics, calculations, simulations or specifications.

We are seeking an experienced Vice President, Sales – EMEA to lead StackAdapt's sales organization across the UK, Spain, Germany, France and the UAE. This leader will own the regional sales strategy and lead a geographically dispersed team of sales leaders and Sales Managers, with London as the hub and team members in each of our continental European and Middle Eastern markets.

This role is responsible for driving revenue growth across independent agencies and brands. In the UK, that means owning new and existing brands and independent agencies. In Spain, Germany, France and the UAE, it means building and scaling markets where teams sell across segments, inclusive of holding companies. The ideal candidate brings deep DSP and programmatic advertising experience, strong relationships across the EMEA advertising ecosystem, and a proven track record of leading high-performing sales organizations across multiple markets.

This leader will partner closely with UK Enterprise Sales leadership, Client Services, Agency Development, Marketing, Product, Solutions, Inventory Partnerships, Sales Enablement, Data & Analytics, and Revenue Operations to strengthen StackAdapt's market position and accelerate growth across EMEA.

StackAdapt is a remote-first company; however, our sales teams operate regionally. For this role, we are prioritising candidates located in the UK or EU, ideally in commutable distance to our London hub.

What You'll Be Doing:

EMEA Sales Strategy & Growth

  • Own and execute the sales strategy for the UK, Spain, Germany, France and the UAE, with accountability for regional revenue growth, new customer acquisition, and expansion within existing accounts.
  • Develop differentiated strategies, organizational structure, and hiring needs for independent agencies, holding companies, and direct brands, reflecting how each buys and how buying behavior varies across markets.
  • Build market-by-market playbooks. Germany, France, UAE, and Spain each have distinct agency landscapes, buying cycles and privacy expectations.
  • Establish a consistent regional operating rhythm for targets, pipeline health, forecasting, territory strategy and overall sales performance.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal and Deal Desk to maintain deal quality and sustainable commercial terms.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and develop a geographically dispersed organization of sales leaders and Account Executives across the UK, continental Europe and the UAE, selling across independent agencies and direct brands.
  • Build leadership depth in each market and set clear expectations, operating rhythms and accountability across time zones and cultures.
  • Recruit, coach and develop high-performing sales talent, including the first local leaders in expansion markets, while fostering a connected regional culture.
  • Support the team on strategic opportunities, complex negotiations and executive customer relationships.

Customer & Market Leadership

  • Build executive-level relationships across independent agencies, holding companies, and brands in each market.
  • Partner with UK Enterprise Sales leadership on multi-market and Holding Company accounts, with a clear operating model to ensure a consistent StackAdapt service motion. Serve as a senior DSP and programmatic leader in strategic pitches, platform evaluations and competitive conversations.
  • Represent StackAdapt with senior customers, partners and industry stakeholders across EMEA.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner across UK Enterprise Sales, Client Services, Agency Development, Product, Solutions, Marketing, Inventory Partnerships, Sales Enablement, Data & Analytics and Revenue Operations to execute an integrated EMEA go-to-market strategy.
  • Bring EMEA voice of customer and market insights into company strategy, product development and investment decisions, including regional privacy and data requirements.
  • Use data and market intelligence to identify growth opportunities, improve sales performance and prioritize resources across markets.

What You'll Bring to the Table

  • Experience balancing an established core business with building newer markets, and knowing when an account warrants an enterprise approach.
  • Significant sales leadership experience within a demand-side platform (DSP) or directly comparable programmatic advertising business.
  • Deep knowledge of the European and Middle Eastern programmatic advertising ecosystem and how agencies and brands evaluate and adopt DSPs.
  • Proven track record of owning and exceeding regional revenue targets across multiple EMEA markets.
  • Demonstrated success selling to independent agencies and direct brands, with exposure to Holding Company structures and agency trading relationships.
  • Experience leading geographically dispersed, multi-country sales teams and sales leaders, including hiring first local leaders in new markets.
  • Understanding of privacy-first selling, including GDPR and consent requirements that shape how brands and agencies buy.
  • Strong operational discipline across forecasting, pipeline management, territory planning and performance management.
  • Comfort working across time zones with North American leadership and regional teams.
  • Executive presence and the ability to influence customers, cross-functional partners and senior leadership.

About the role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained — both on the job and through formal programs led by a world-class Sales team — to take on your next role as a closing Account Executive. On a daily basis, you will build and work a portfolio of target accounts for our EMEA business in the DACH region: researching each account for commercial signal, prioritising which contacts to approach and in what order, and running a connected, multi-touch outbound motion that generates qualified pipeline rather than one-off meetings.

We have offices in Paris and Amsterdam, and offer remote working from Germany, France, the Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

You should apply if

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: your efforts will result in real-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: if you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
  • You’re excited by AI: you’ll use cutting-edge AI tools every day and sell some of the most advanced AI in the physical operations space.
  • You think several moves ahead: you'd rather build a real relationship across an account than force a single contact to a decision they're not ready to make.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: one day you'll be researching a transport operator, the next a food distribution centre. Our best reps dig into the businesses they support to make a sharper case for why Samsara matters to them specifically.
  • You treat rejection as a learning experience: in this role you will get hung up on and told no. You need the resilience to prepare, call again, and adjust.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go further than you have before.

In this role, you will

  • Research target accounts before outreach — pulling commercial signal out of public information (financials, news, hiring activity, compliance or safety pressure) to build a specific, defensible point of view on where Samsara adds value.
  • Build and prioritise an account-level contact plan, identifying who to approach first across a range of stakeholders (e.g. MD, Operations/Transport Manager, Compliance/H&S, Finance) and being able to justify that choice.
  • Run a connected, multi-touch outbound motion across phone, email and LinkedIn — using early conversations to gather information and multi-thread the account, not just to book a meeting at any cost.
  • Write personalised, researched outreach (including cold emails) that carries a specific point of view into every call, rather than working from a generic script.
  • Read what a contact gives you on the call and adapt in real time — including recognising when the right move is to gather information and position a follow-up with someone else, rather than push for a meeting the contact can't actually commit to.
  • Keep meticulous account and contact records in Salesforce.
  • Become a product expert and represent the Samsara brand at trade shows and events.

  • 1–3 years professional experience, ideally in customer-facing roles
  • 6–12 months experience in a sales or equivalent target driven role
  • Highly motivated and committed, with a strong desire to work in target-driven sales
  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding targets in previous roles
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Curious, and able to ask insightful questions
  • A champion of a Growth Mindset
  • Highly proficient in English and fluent in German
  • AI Literacy and ability to showcase examples of leveraging AI in your work

An ideal candidate also has

  • Comfort turning unstructured information (an annual report, a website, a news article) into a clear commercial argument
  • Experience multi-threading or navigating multiple stakeholders within a single sale
  • A genuine willingness to prepare — to research and write — before a call, rather than relying on improvising well under pressure
  • Experience in closing-sales roles or similar target driven environment
  • A proven track record of achievement beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity)
  • Willingness to collaborate and influence in a "win as a team" environment
  • Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space.

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility. With emphasis on continued professional development, training doesn't stop after onboarding — we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and competitors, develop hard skills, and work with mentors to progress through three levels:

At NerdWallet, we’re on a mission to bring clarity to all of life’s financial decisions and every great mission needs a team of exceptional Nerds. NerdWallet is looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to lead the technical direction for bringing NerdWallet's financial guidance into the AI assistants consumers already use. More and more people start their financial decisions with a conversation instead of a search. We want NerdWallet's trusted guidance to be there when they do.

You'll architect and build NerdWallet's apps and integrations on leading third-party AI platforms. That means production LLM-backed systems that run inside environments we don't control: they have to stay accurate, grounded in trusted content, and compliant in a highly regulated domain, while adapting to fast-moving platform capabilities, protocols, and policies. You'll be the senior technical voice across the platform integration teams and partner closely with the team that owns the shared services these integrations run on.

This is a hands-on role. The ideal candidate writes a lot of code, sets the architectural bar, and makes the engineers around them better.

You're a staff engineer who is energized by building on brand-new platforms where the playbook doesn't exist yet. You'll turn ambiguous product bets into clear technical plans, then build the critical parts yourself. You'll define how NerdWallet shows up across multiple AI platforms, balancing what should be shared against what needs to be platform-specific so each team can move fast and independently. You're a trusted technical advisor to Engineering Managers and Product Managers, you raise the quality bar through design and code review, and you mentor engineers on building reliable systems on top of non-deterministic models. You stay close to the rapidly changing AI ecosystem and help NerdWallet decide where to invest.

This role reports to the Director, Engineering.

Where you can make an impact:

  • Lead the technical direction for AI platform integrations. Own the architecture for how NerdWallet's guidance is packaged, exposed, and rendered inside third-party AI assistants, from tool and protocol design to in-conversation UI.

  • Build a lot of it yourself. Write production code for new integrations, prototype new platform capabilities as they launch, and unblock teams on the hardest technical problems.

  • Design for reuse across platforms. Define the abstractions, contracts, and patterns that let multiple platform teams share a common foundation while still using each platform's unique features.

  • Adapt as platforms change. Track evolving platform protocols, SDKs, review processes, and policies. Turn those changes into roadmap and architecture decisions before they become blockers.

  • Make quality measurable. Help define eval and testing strategy for platform integrations, including automated evals, regression suites, and end-to-end tests across environments you don't fully control.

  • Build safely for a regulated domain. Partner with Security, Legal, and Compliance so integrations handle authentication, consent, and sensitive consumer data correctly and follow financial compliance requirements.

  • Own reliability and performance. Set standards for monitoring, latency, cost, and incident response on platform-facing services, and help resolve production issues when they happen.

  • Raise the engineering bar. Lead design reviews, set coding and architecture standards, and conduct code reviews that model what good looks like.

  • Mentor and multiply. Coach engineers across FTE and contractor teams on system design, LLM-backed development, and good engineering practices.

  • Partner with leadership on the roadmap. Work with Engineering Managers and Product to shape priorities, estimate effort and risk honestly, and recommend where to place technical bets.

  • Use data to guide decisions. Dig into usage and performance data to find where integrations are working, where they aren't, and what to build next.

Your experience:

  • 8+ years in software engineering, with at least 3+ years at the Staff level and deep hands-on experience building and operating production backend systems.

  • A track record of technical leadership: architecting complex systems end to end, leading a team through hard technical problems, establishing best practices, and mentoring other engineers.

  • Hands-on experience building production features on LLMs: tool use/function calling, MCP or similar protocols, prompt and context design, retrieval (RAG), evals, and handling non-deterministic output.

  • Advanced knowledge of a modern TypeScript stack (e.g., Node.js, React, GraphQL, Postgres, Redis), with the judgment to evaluate unfamiliar codebases, SDKs, and vendor tools.

  • Experience designing APIs and shared services that other teams build on, including versioning, backward compatibility, and balancing competing consumer needs.

  • Experience building on third-party platforms or ecosystems (e.g., app stores, plugin/extension ecosystems, partner APIs) where you work within someone else's constraints and review processes.

  • Strong understanding of authentication and authorization patterns (e.g., OAuth) and security best practices for handling sensitive data.

  • Comfort with early-stage, zero-to-one work where the product, platform, and process are being defined as you go.

  • Strong communication skills: you can explain AI system behavior, tradeoffs, and risk clearly to engineers, product partners, and leadership.

  • Experience mentoring engineers across blended FTE and vendor/contractor teams.

  • Comfort in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift as platforms and user behavior evolve.

Revenue Readiness owns how Huntress prepares revenue teams to perform. As Director of Revenue Readiness, you will set the vision and build the function that turns company priorities, process changes, product launches, and evolving selling expectations into a coordinated readiness strategy.

You will lead across the revenue organization to establish the governance, operating standards, learning systems, and program discipline needed to prepare sellers and frontline managers consistently across roles, segments, motions, and geographies. As part of our global team, you'll thrive in an environment that champions curiosity, collaboration, and innovation, all while making meaningful contributions to the brands we accelerate.

Join us in shaping the future of communication and building authentic connections that matter. Whether you're solving complex problems or driving bold innovations, your growth is our success, and together, we’ll create the conversations of tomorrow.

Empower your impact at Cision. Be seen, be understood, be you.

What You'll Do

Own and deliver expansion ARR quota and renewal performance within assigned Commercial accounts.

Develop and execute structured account plans focused on multi-product adoption and wallet-share growth.

Lead complex discovery and expansion conversations across multi-stakeholder buying groups.

Drive disciplined renewal strategy, negotiation, and retention execution.

Manage larger deal sizes and moderate sales cycle complexity.

Maintain accurate revenue forecasting and pipeline inspection discipline.

Partner cross-functionally with CX, Product, and Solutions to ensure alignment on expansion strategy.

Identify commercial risk signals and proactively mitigate renewal exposure.

Ensure clean commercial handoffs where role transitions are required.

Perform other duties and responsibilities as required to support business needs.

What You'll Bring

Mastery knowledge of industry best practices and disciplines. Considered a subject matter expert within the organization and contributes to the development of new concepts, techniques and standards.

Develops solutions to highly complex and uniquely challenging situations. Assignments require extensive evaluation of alternatives and variables. Expected to make improvements to policies and procedures.

Works independently toward long-range goals and objectives. Assignments are often self-initiated using independent judgment and discretion. May act as informal team lead and/or coach less experienced team.

Serves as consultant to management and/or internal/external spokesperson for the organization on major initiatives related to policies, plans and long-range objectives.

Actions may impact on the organization and its reputation. Effects of erroneous decisions may be long-lasting, influence the future course of the organization and/or require the expenditure of extensive additional resources.

Experience managing Commercial account portfolios with ARR responsibility.

Demonstrated ability to drive expansion and renewal growth in multi-stakeholder environments.

Strong negotiation and commercial strategy capability.

Experience with structured sales methodologies.

Education: University degree preferred.

Experience managing multi-product portfolios.

Experience supporting Commercial or mid-market segments.

Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

We are seeking a seasoned Associate General Counsel, Commercial to lead the legal function behind Motive's revenue, partnerships, and procurement as the company scales globally. This is a senior, high-visibility role: you will be the trusted legal advisor to our CRO, CFO, and Procurement leaders, helping them move fast and take smart risks across the contract lifecycle.

This is a player-coach role. You will build and lead a team of attorneys and contract managers, and mentoring and developing junior attorneys will be a core part of the job. You will stay close to the work by personally drafting and negotiating the most complex and strategic deals. You will also be a builder of systems, creating playbooks, approval matrices, and deal desk processes, and bringing an AI-first approach to legal work. You will report to the VP, Legal and play a central role in shaping the legal team's strategic impact and operational excellence.

What You'll Do:

  • Serve as the senior legal partner to the CRO, CFO, and Procurement leadership, advising on deal strategy and balancing speed against risk.
  • Lead the negotiation of complex enterprise, strategic, and reseller agreements, including MSAs, SaaS and hardware/software bundles, SLAs, warranty, and data and security terms, and personally draft and negotiate the highest-impact deals.
  • Structure and negotiate strategic partnerships, resellers, OEM and integration arrangements, joint ventures, and other strategic transactions.
  • Support international expansion, including local entity setup, regional partners and distributors, localized contract frameworks, and coordination with local counsel across the EU, UK, APAC, LATAM, and other regions.
  • Lead procurement and supply chain legal for technology, manufacturing, and logistics vendors.
  • Build and manage a team of attorneys and contract managers.
  • Actively mentor and develop junior attorneys through coaching, delegation, and regular feedback, setting clear career paths and growing the next generation of legal leaders.
  • Create and maintain contract playbooks, fallback and approval matrices, templates, and deal desk processes that let the business scale efficiently and consistently.
  • Drive an AI-first approach to legal work by deploying AI-assisted drafting, redlining, and review, CLM automation, and intake and triage workflows, along with self-service templates and tiered approval thresholds.
  • Track and report on the impact of the function, including cycle time, cost per contract, and outside counsel spend, and manage outside counsel effectively.

What We're Looking For:

  • Senior commercial legal depth. 15+ years of total experience across law firm and in-house practice, including at least 5 years in an in-house leadership role (Associate General Counsel, Deputy General Counsel, or Head of Commercial Legal) at a company of scale.
  • Top-tier pedigree. In-house experience at a recognized high-growth or category-leading technology company (SaaS, IoT, hardware, marketplace, or platform), paired with a top law firm background.
  • Proven revenue impact and global growth. Supported a company's growth in revenue to $1B+ in annual revenue or ARR, including growth driven by international expansion. Experience on individual deals and programs worth $50M+ is a plus.
  • Leadership and business partnership. Built and managed teams (a mix of attorneys and contract managers). A trusted advisor to the CRO, CFO, and Procurement leaders who balances speed against risk. You still draft and negotiate personally, with recent experience in the weeds, not just overseeing.
  • Committed mentor and developer of junior attorneys. A track record of structuring, mentoring, and developing attorneys through hands-on coaching, thoughtful delegation, real-time feedback, and clear career paths, and of growing future leaders. You take genuine pride in the people you have developed and see their growth as part of your own success.
  • Full-cycle sales and enterprise contracting. Led negotiation of complex enterprise, strategic, and reseller deals, with a record of shortening sales cycles.
  • Builder of systems and AI-first efficiency. Created contract playbooks, fallback and approval matrices, templates, and deal desk processes. Has adopted AI-first approaches to legal work.
  • A true team player who’s happy to pitch in wherever needed, whether that’s your own deal queue or someone else’s fire drill at quarter-end.
  • Someone who genuinely enjoys working with others, actively shares knowledge, fosters strong working relationships, and can partner with others to achieve shared goals.
  • Someone with a great sense of humor and no ego who shares our vision that the legal team can be both a center of excellence and fun at the same time!

**The posted salary range reflects the national range. Candidates located in San Francisco, New York, or Seattle may be eligible for a salary adjustment based on geographic location and experience.

Pay Transparency

Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visiting Motive Perks & Benefits.

We are a leading trading platform that is ambitiously expanding to the four corners of the globe. Our top-rated products have won prestigious industry awards for their cutting-edge technology and seamless client experience. We deliver only the best, so we are always in search of the best people to join our ever-growing talented team.

We’re seeking a Senior Product Designer to join our Web team, dedicated to crafting exceptional digital experiences for a global audience. In this role, you’ll take ownership of Capital.com’s web presence — from marketing pages and landing experiences to product-facing web interfaces — working closely with brand, engineering, and product teams to bring compelling designs to life.

Responsibilities:

  • Create visually compelling, high-quality web experiences that reflect our brand and engage our global audience.
  • Own the design of marketing pages, landing pages, and web product interfaces end-to-end.
  • Be the voice of the user, embedding their needs into every design decision with insights and research.
  • Work hand-in-hand with product, engineering, and brand stakeholders to transform ideas into reality.
  • Develop interactive prototypes to test and illustrate design concepts.
  • Define and maintain design guidelines, bringing consistency across all web touchpoints.
  • Lead design initiatives with balance and clarity, adapting to timelines while juggling multiple priorities.
  • Design user journeys that turn complex tasks into simple, delightful experiences.
  • Improve web performance post-launch, focusing on continuous, user-centered enhancements.
  • Collaborate with the Design System team to ensure consistency across all web surfaces.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience designing web products and digital experiences.
  • A portfolio showcasing strong web design work — marketing pages, landing experiences, or product web interfaces.
  • Proficiency in Figma and strong knowledge of components and design systems.
  • Experience with modern web design tools such as Framer or Webflow is a plus.
  • Strong visual design sense with an eye for typography, layout, and motion.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to articulate design decisions clearly.
  • Skilled at understanding the technical impact of design choices for web.
  • Self-directed, with the ability to take ownership of the design process.
  • Strong UX focus and a deep understanding of human behavior.
  • A continuous learner, eager to grow both personally and with the team.
  • Proactive, confident, and effective communicator — able to present work and articulate design decisions clearly to a range of stakeholders.

What you will get in return:

  • Competitive Salary: We believe great work deserves great pay! Your skills and talents will be rewarded with a salary that makes you feel valued and motivated.
  • Work-Life Harmony: Join a company that genuinely cares about you—because your life outside of work matters just as much as your time on the clock. #LI-Hybrid
  • Annual Performance Bonus: Your hard work doesn’t go unnoticed! Celebrate your achievements with a well-deserved annual bonus tied to your performance.
  • Generous Time Off: Need a breather? Our annual leave policy lets you recharge and enjoy life outside of work without a worry.
  • Employee Referral Program: Love working here? Share the love! Bring your talented friends on board and get rewarded for growing our awesome team.
  • Comprehensive Health & Pension Benefits: From medical insurance to pension plans, we’ve got your back. Plus, location-specific benefits and perks!
  • Workation Wonderland: Live your digital nomad dreams with 30 extra days to work remotely from anywhere in the world (some restrictions apply). Adventure awaits!
  • Volunteer Days: Make a difference! Take two additional paid days each year to support causes you care about and give back to the community.

Compensation
